context.text:
Project Falcon – status update

The migration of the customer database to the new platform is 80% complete. Three of the five regional databases have been moved without downtime. The remaining two (APAC and LATAM) are scheduled for the weekend of 14 November.

Budget: we have spent 1.2 million of the approved 1.5 million euros. The extra licence costs for the monitoring tool (about 60,000 euros) were not in the original budget.

Risks: the LATAM database has an unsupported character encoding that must be converted first. If the conversion fails, the go-live date of 1 December may slip by up to two weeks. The team recommends a test conversion next week.

note: Tjekker også dansk talformat (1,2 mio.) og datoformat.
rubric: Naturligt dansk, dansk talformat, alle tal, datoer og risici bevaret.
